newsitem.title: FRANCE: GOLF-MONTGOMERIE IN PURSUIT OF GOOSEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MONTGOMERIE IN PURSUIT OF GOOSEN.

text.p: South African Retief Goosen completed an eight-under-par 64 after picking up two strokes when he resumed his rain- affected French Open first round at the National Golf Club on Friday.
It earned him a three-shot lead in the clubhouse. But out on the course, tournament favourite Colin Montgomerie was mounting a determined bid to catch the 28-year-old South African.
The burly Scot, second in the U.S. Open two weeks ago and looking for a second successive European Tour win, moved to within three strokes of Goosen with five birdies over the first 13 holes.
With five holes remaining, he was joint second with Italian Massimo Florioli, who finished his round with a 67.
Persistent rain on Thursday prevented completion of the opening round. Officials planned to begin the second round later on Friday.
